items.prompt: A workshop has 240 minutes. It schedules three 35-minute sessions, two 12-minute breaks, and 28 minutes of setup. How many minutes remain? Answer with one number only.
A device costs $80. Apply a 15% discount first, then 8% tax to the discounted price. What is the final price in dollars? Answer with one number only.
A score is 72 with weight 2, 88 with weight 3, and 94 with weight 5. What is the weighted mean? Answer with one number only.
A recipe uses 4 cups of oats for every 3 cups of water. How many cups of water are needed for 10 cups of oats? Answer with one number only.
A shipment contains 432 parts. Remove 24 damaged parts, then divide the remainder equally among 6 teams. How many parts per team? Answer with one number only.
Inventory starts at 37 units, receives four boxes of 18, then ships three orders of 15. How many units remain? Answer with one number only.
Five workers each process 6 tickets per hour for 4 hours. If 15% of processed tickets need rework, how many are accepted? Answer with one number only.
A tank is one quarter full at 48 liters capacity. Add three containers of 7.5 liters each, then drain 5 liters. How many liters remain? Answer with one number only.

A team can do one task next. A is due at 14:00 and takes 20 minutes; B is due at 13:00 and takes 45 minutes; C is due at 13:30 and takes 10 minutes. It is now 12:00. Choose the task with the earliest deadline, not the shortest duration.
A. A
B. B
C. C
D. They have the same deadline
Answer with one letter only.

Publish a report only when status is approved and at least two reviewers signed. Which record qualifies? A: approved, 1 signer; B: pending, 3 signers; C: approved, 2 signers; D: approved, 0 signers.
A. Record A
B. Record B
C. Record C
D. Record D
Answer with one letter only.

A delivery must use a route under 30 km and with no toll. North is 24 km with a toll; East is 31 km without a toll; South is 27 km without a toll; West is 20 km with a toll. Which route meets both rules?
A. North
B. East
C. South
D. West
Answer with one letter only.

A note says: “The spare key is stored in the cabinet. The cabinet code is not recorded.” Which claim is supported by the note?
A. The key is in the cabinet.
B. The code is 0000.
C. The cabinet is locked.
D. The key is missing.
Answer with one letter only.

Choose a supplier that meets all requirements: delivery within 5 days, warranty at least 2 years, and price below $500. Alder: 4 days, 1 year, $420. Birch: 6 days, 3 years, $390. Cedar: 5 days, 2 years, $480. Dogwood: 3 days, 3 years, $510.
A. Alder
B. Birch
C. Cedar
D. Dogwood
Answer with one letter only.

A job may start only after both review and backup are complete. Review is complete; backup is pending. What is the correct status?
A. Ready to start
B. Blocked until backup completes
C. Cancelled
D. Unknown because review is incomplete
Answer with one letter only.

A sequence follows this rule: add 3, then multiply by 2, repeating those operations. It begins 2, 5, 10, 13, ... What is the next value?
A. 16
B. 26
C. 32
D. 29
Answer with one letter only.

A file is eligible for deletion only if it is duplicated, backed up, and not marked keep. Which file is eligible? A: duplicate, backed up, keep. B: duplicate, not backed up, not keep. C: unique, backed up, not keep. D: duplicate, backed up, not keep.
A. A
B. B
C. C
D. D
Answer with one letter only.

items.prompt: From a repair log, report ticket 17, 2 attempts, resolved=true. Return JSON with integer ticket=17, integer attempts=2, boolean resolved=true. Return only JSON with exactly the requested fields.
A crate has 12 items; 3 are damaged. Report received, damaged, usable. Return JSON with integer received=12, damaged=3, usable=9. Return only JSON with exactly the requested fields.

A study has group A with 8 people and group B with 11. Report both counts and the total. Return JSON with groups object A=8 and B=11, and integer total=19. Return only JSON with exactly the requested fields.

A device is named Atlas, has 64 GB free, and is encrypted. Report these fields. Return JSON with string device="Atlas", integer free_gb=64, boolean encrypted=true. Return only JSON with exactly the requested fields.

Three checks have statuses pass, pass, fail. Report the ordered statuses and pass count. Return JSON with statuses array ["pass","pass","fail"] and integer passed=2. Return only JSON with exactly the requested fields.

A meeting starts at 09:15 and lasts 50 minutes. Report start and end as 24-hour HH:MM strings. Return JSON with string start="09:15" and end="10:05". Return only JSON with exactly the requested fields.

A request has id R-8, priority high, and is waiting. Report all three fields. Return JSON with string id="R-8", string priority="high", boolean waiting=true. Return only JSON with exactly the requested fields.

A batch expected 7 records and all 7 were processed: 5 accepted and 2 rejected. Report both counts and complete=true. Return JSON with integer accepted=5, integer rejected=2, boolean complete=true. Return only JSON with exactly the requested fields.
